name: WPWF World Title
epitaph: Named in the WPWF's own founding recruitment ads (26-27 March 1997) as one of three original championships; the operator's 11 April relaunch notice rebuilt it as a Battle Royal prize under an unchanged name.
notes: No title change is recorded on either served results card (Battle of the Titans, We Ain't Role Models) — results-free; no reign is minted.

name: WPWF World Tag Team Titles
epitaph: Named in the WPWF's own founding recruitment ads (26-27 March 1997) and carried unchanged through the 11 April relaunch notice, which rebuilt it as a tournament prize.
notes: No title change is recorded on either served results card — results-free; no reign is minted.

name: WPWF Television Title
epitaph: Named in the WPWF's own founding recruitment ads (26-27 March 1997) as the third original championship; dropped from the title list in the 11 April relaunch notice.
notes: No title change is recorded on either served results card — results-free; no reign is minted.

name: WPWF Extreme Title
epitaph: Introduced in the operator's 11 April 1997 relaunch notice, to be decided by a tournament of Extreme-rules matches (Death Matches, Barbed Wire Matches) and defended only in such matches.
notes: No results card postdating the relaunch survives in the held record — results-free; no reign is minted.

name: WPWF Unified American Title
epitaph: Introduced in the operator's 11 April 1997 relaunch notice as the fed's own American championship, to be decided by tournament.
notes: No results card postdating the relaunch survives in the held record — results-free; no reign is minted.
